text: 你和诺曼沿着猿人留下的原始踪迹前进。踪迹带你们来到山间灌木丛中的一片洼地。弥漫不散的气味、足迹和散落物品都表明，猿人——大脚怪——大约一小时前还在此扎营。
“看！”诺曼指着洼地对面喊道，“是西尔维娅！”你们朝她跑去。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 192
text: You and Norman follow the original trail left by the ape-man. It leads you to a hollow in the mountain thickets. The pervasive odor, the tracks, and litter indicate to you that the ape-men— the sasquatches—had camped here but an hour ago.
“Look!” Norman cries, pointing to a figure across the hollow. “It’s Sylvia!” You run to her.
